metadata.title: Real-mode AI/ML batch inference workload (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.description: Batch and near-real-time inference pipelines scoring transactions using ensembles hosted on Azure ML with AKS-backed endpoints.
technologyStack: Azure Container Registry for model images
Azure Monitor + Prometheus for GPU metrics
Entra ID for operator and pipeline principals
reviewObjectives: Balance GPU quota, cost, and queue latency
Validate secure promotion from training to batch endpoints
Review model registry immutability and separation of duties
constraints: Inferencing p95 < 400ms for synchronous regional API
Models must be signed before production traffic
Training data sources are geo-fenced (US only)

inputSummary: Azure ML with GPU-backed AKS inferencing, batch endpoints, and registry RBAC. Synthetic AI/ML workload archetype for golden cohort.

qualityEvidence.notes: Reference AOAI deployment: gpt-4o per tests/golden-cohort/budget.config.json baselineModelSku.
